bio.text: Peggy Flanagan, Minnesota's lieutenant governor, won the DFL nomination for U.S. Senate in the August 11, 2026 primary, defeating U.S. Rep. Angie Craig, and faces Republican Michele Tafoya in November.
According to her KAXE candidate survey response, she lives in St. Louis Park.
She is a member of the White Earth Band of Ojibwe and served on the Minneapolis Board of Education and as a Wellstone Action trainer before becoming lieutenant governor, according to KEYC.
In her KAXE survey response she also listed leading Children's Defense Fund-Minnesota, serving in the Minnesota House, and graduating from the University of Minnesota.

sources.title: Lt. Gov. Flanagan officially becomes a Senate candidate
Flanagan wins DFL duel in Senate race, Tafoya claims GOP nod for open seat
